title: Mihile — complete skill frame set
source: maplestory.io, GMS version 270 (skillbook API for jobs 5000/5100/5110/5111/5112/5114; WZ API for V/HEXA)

skills.name: Soul Shield
skills.description: Amplifies Soul Shield's power to have strength in enduring the enemy's attack.

skills.name: Soul Devotion
skills.description: Permanently increases Speed, Jump, and Max Speed.

skills.name: Righteous Indignation
skills.description: Inflict more fatal damage with the power of light when attacking enemies with Blind.

skills.name: Weightless Heart
skills.description: Leap once more while already in the air. Press the up key at the same time to move upward. The higher the skill, the farther the jumping distance.

skills.name: Shining Pierce
skills.description:
[Radiant Soul Skill]
Materialize a sharp sword of light to pierce the enemy.

skills.name: Royal Guard
skills.description:
Soul Shield nullifies enemy attacks and counterattacks. Counterattacks are unaffected by attack ignore and attack reflection. The Invincibility effect and Attack Power increase buffs are not affected by the Buff Duration increase effect.
You can guard while using skills.

skills.name: Royal Guard
skills.description: Soul Shield nullifies enemy attacks and makes you invincible.

skills.name: Physical Training
skills.description: Permanently increases STR and DEX through sheer physical training.

skills.name: Sword Mastery
skills.description: Increases One-handed Sword Mastery, Attack Power, and Final Damage.

skills.name: Final Attack
skills.description: Chance to deliver an additional hit after a direct attack skill. Must have a one-handed sword equipped.

skills.name: Agile Swords
skills.description: Increases Attack Speed and Strength.

skills.name: Encourage
skills.description: Encourage allies to increase the Attack Power of party members including yourself for a short time. Also increases the power of Lv. 1 - 3 Royal Guard's counterattack.

skills.name: Four-Point Assault
skills.description:
[Radiant Soul Skill]
Attack by launching a sword formed with soul power at the enemy in front.

skills.name: Radiant Driver
skills.description: Drives back multiple enemies with a brilliant shield of light. Can be resisted by some enemies.

skills.name: Self Recovery
skills.description: Regularly recover some HP and MP, even in combat.

skills.name: Loyal Oath
skills.description: Harden your loyal oath to the Empress.

skills.name: Advanced Righteous Indignation
skills.description: Enhances the effect of Righteous Indignation to inflict more fatal damage on the enemy with the power of light.

skills.name: Soul Link
skills.description: Connect your soul to nearby allies to unify and bolster your powers. Periodically enhances party members in the Soul Link's range. When Royal Guard's counterattack succeeds, party members in the Soul Link's range are protected.

skills.name: Advanced Royal Guard
skills.description: Enhances Royal Guard to do a powerful counterattack when guarding multiple hits in a row. Better control of the Soul Shield enhances your ability to endure enemy attacks.

skills.name: Offensive Defense
skills.description:
The power of the shield protecting the Empress makes enemies vulnerable to Mihile's Radiant Soul. Enemies hit with Royal Guard's counterattack receive a debuff. Using Radiant Soul skill to attack enemies with the debuff creates a light shockwave that does an additional attack.
The light shockwave is centered on the enemy hit with the Radiant Soul skill.

skills.name: Magic Crash
skills.description:
Chance to remove certain buffs from affected enemies and prevent them regaining those buffs.
Enemies hit will resist Magic Crash for 90 seconds. Buffs Removed: Attack Power & Magic ATT Bonuses, DEF Bonuses, and Obsidian Skin.

skills.name: Soul Release
skills.description:
[Radiant Soul Skill]
Attacks the enemy in front by releasing the strong light power condensed in the Soul Shield.

skills.name: Royal Guard
skills.description: Soul Shield nullifies enemy attacks and makes you invincible.

skills.name: Royal Guard
skills.description: Soul Shield nullifies enemy attacks and makes you invincible.

skills.name: Soul Link - Resonance
skills.description: Mihile's will to guard creates a protective shield by resonating deep within the soul through Royal Guard.

skills.name: Combat Mastery
skills.description: Ignores a portion of the enemy's defense while attacking.

skills.name: Expert Sword Mastery
skills.description: Improves One-handed Sword mastery to their human limits. Increases Attack Power, Critical Rate, and Critical Damage.

skills.name: Advanced Final Attack
skills.description: Permanently increases Attack Power. Greatly increases activation rate and damage of Final Attack.

skills.name: Soul Asylum
skills.description: Uses the enhanced power of the Soul Shield to enhance Royal Guard. Also permanently decrease damage received from enemies, and increases Max HP.

skills.name: Power Stance
skills.description: Concentrates to hold your ground when struck, resisting knock-back effects permanently.

skills.name: Advanced Offensive Defense
skills.description: Raises a firm shield that keeps up before enemies to enhance Offensive Defense and Royal Guard's counterattack.

skills.name: Royal Guard - Enhance
skills.description: Enhances the effect when Soul Asylum's Royal Guard succeeds, increasing the damage reduction rate of attacks that inflict damage at a certain ratio to Max HP when Royal Guard succeeds.

skills.name: Royal Guard - Guardbreak
skills.description: Increases Ignore Defense for Royal Guard.

skills.name: Royal Guard - Persist
skills.description: Increases the duration of the effect that is activated when Soul Asylum's Royal Guard succeeds.

skills.name: Install Shield - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases Damage of Install Shield.

skills.name: Install Shield - Spread
skills.description: Increases the max number of enemies hit by Install Shield.

skills.name: Install Shield - Persist
skills.description: Increases the duration of Install Shield.

skills.name: Radiant Cross - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases Damage of Radiant Cross and Radiant Cross - Assault.

skills.name: Radiant Cross - Guardbreak
skills.description: Increases Ignore Defense of Radiant Cross and Radiant Cross - Assault.

skills.name: Radiant Cross - Extra Strike
skills.description: Increases the number of attacks for Radiant Cross and Radiant Cross - Assault.

skills.name: Call of Cygnus
skills.description: The Empress's blessing increases your stats. Using the skill briefly makes the Empress appear.

skills.name: Roiling Soul
skills.description:
Sharpens the sword and shield with the power of soul to permanently increase Critical Damage and Final Damage. When toggled on, increases the chance to inflect Blind for Radiant Soul skills.
Can be toggled On/Off.

skills.name: Radiant Cross
skills.description:
[Radiant Soul Skill]
Slice ahead with a cross-shaped light. Enhances Radiant Cross - Assault while Roiling Soul is active.

skills.name: Cygnus Knights' Will
skills.description:
Hones your resolve to ignore certain abnormal status effects. Immune to most abnormal status effects for 3 sec. after use. Certain abnormal status effects will still get through. Does not apply Combat Orders.
Can be used while using other skills.

skills.name: Install Shield
skills.description: Summons the Soul Shield containing the power of light. The Soul Shield can be installed in the air, and periodically emits light to attack enemies.

skills.name: Radiant Cross - Assault
skills.description:
[Radiant Soul Skill]
Slice ahead diagonally by sharply condensing the power of light.

skills.name: Charging Light
skills.description:
[Radiant Soul Skill]
Summons the mighty Knight of Light that can use the power of the soul to carry out a deadly charge.

skills.name: Queen of Tomorrow
skills.description: Receive the Empress's Blessing to increase your damage.

skills.name: Soul Majesty
skills.description:
Your firm belief to guard the Empress and allies makes the Soul Shield and Radiant Soul skill to display a stronger power. While active, increases Damage and enhances Soul Asylum's effect.
Also, Install Shield leaves an Offensive Defense debuff, and enhances Offensive Defense.

skills.name: HEXA Final Attack
skills.description: Chance to deliver an additional hit after a direct attack skill. Must have a one-handed sword equipped.

skills.name: HEXA Radiant Cross
skills.description:
[Radiant Soul Skill]
Focuses light energy into a frontal attack in the shape of a cross. Upgrades to HEXA Radiant Cross - Assault while Roiling Soul is active.

skills.name: HEXA Radiant Cross - Assault
skills.description:
[Radiant Soul Skill]
Slice ahead diagonally by sharply focusing the power of light.

skills.name: Durendal
skills.description:
[Radiant Soul Skill]
Annihilates evil with a sword of light that never dulls.
Applies Royal Guard buff at max stacks.

Lv. 10 - Ignore Defense: +20%
Lv. 20 - Boss Damage: +20%
Lv. 30 - Ignore Defense: +30%, Boss Damage: +30%

skills.name: Knights Immortal
skills.description:
[Radiant Soul Skill]
Summons the Knights Immortal, whose undying valor lives on in eternal light.

Lv. 10 - Ignore Defense: +10%, Boss Damage: +10%
Lv. 20 - Ignore Defense: +10%, Boss Damage: +10%
Lv. 30 - Ignore Defense: +20%
